resources.string: Keep your phone connected by USB and start HandsFree on your laptop. We will reconnect automatically when it is ready.
Tell me what you\'d like to do. We\'ll take it one step at a time.
Need lunch or an afternoon snack? I\'ll ask what you like before looking for options.
Let me help in your apps
Allow screen access so I can read app controls and help with tasks you start.
I\'m checking the next step. You can stop at any time.
What would you like to do?
Tap Start conversation, or type a task
Start once, then speak requests and approvals across apps. Listening pauses during my spoken replies. Say stop conversation to end microphone access.

HandsFree reads app controls and performs actions only for tasks you start. Screen information is processed on your connected computer. Protected authentication fields are excluded. You can stop at any time.

After Start conversation, the microphone stays available across apps and between tasks until you stop. Speech is sent to our speech service; silence is discarded on the phone. I\'ll read approvals aloud so you can answer by voice. Listening pauses while I speak. Stop ends microphone access. Payment remains yours to complete manually.
Could not load apps. Please refresh to try again.
Only installed apps that can be opened appear here. Try another name or refresh after installing an app.
Conversation ended because the phone is locked.
Microphone unavailable. You can use typing.
Voice took too long. Please try again.
I couldn\'t understand that. Please try again.
Voice connection unavailable. You can use typing.
Voice could not start. Please try again.
Voice could not start. You can continue by typing.
Audio unavailable. Read the text response.
I\'m listening. What would you like to do? You can say home, new task, or stop conversation at any time while I\'m listening.
Please say approve, decline, or stop.
I\'ve noted that. I\'ll check the next step with your updated request.
What would you like to do next?
Private input is on screen. Conversation ended. Complete that step yourself, then return Home to start again.
Stopped. No further actions will run.
What would you like to eat? Name something you enjoy, or ask me to suggest options.
What is your total budget? You can also say no budget limit.
Any dietary preferences or allergies? For example, vegetarian, or no restrictions.
How many people or portions should I look for?
When would you like the food? Say now, or tell me a delivery time and day.
Thanks. I\'ll look for options that match what you\'ve told me, then ask you to choose.
Enable HandsFree AI in Accessibility settings first.
Accessibility service disconnected. Enable it and start again.
You can tell me another task, say home, or say stop conversation.
Return to HandsFree home and cancel the task
Conversation stays on. Say stop, or tap Stop to end microphone access.
Finish or stop your task before changing language.
Pauses of 5 seconds send your speech automatically.
%1$s is no longer available. Refresh or choose another app.
Android did not allow %1$s to open. Check its restrictions.
Which app would you like to use? %1$s.
You mentioned %1$s. Do you want delivery by then or to place the order then, and on which day?
Opened %1$s. The active application was verified.
Open the official Play Store listing for %1$s? You decide whether to install.
The cart shows %1$s. The displayed total is %2$s. Are these the items and quantities you want?
Your cart is ready for review. The app displays %1$s to pay. Check the final amount and complete payment yourself. I have not placed an order. Microphone access is ending for payment.
Checking the screen after the action
I couldn\'t connect right now. Check your connection and try again.
